headline: Funds over 5 billion euros for 30% cheaper electricity within three years
summary: The Greek Ministry of Environment and Energy has specified a package of measures backed by over 5 billion euros, aiming for 30% cheaper electricity within three years. Some measures apply immediately and others are medium-term.
why: Electricity costs feed into business input costs and household budgets, and state support schemes shape energy-sector economics and the outlook for utilities.
